$comment: The deny-all fallback, and the template every real fence is copied from. A fence directory is keyed on BOTH community and agent: fences/<community>/<agent>/, with fences/<community>/_default/ for an agent that has none of its own. Copy this to fences/<community>/<agent>/, then list that agent's MCP servers in the .claude.json beside it. _unknown/_default gets none, on purpose — it is where an unmapped community lands.
